messages:
Anya Petrov: Follow-up from the postmortem: two regressions bypassed our canaries. We agreed on guardrail work — adding owners and short timelines here.
Marcus Lee: I'll own auto-rollback rules + idempotent API call. Prototype this week. Plan: combine error-rate + p95 + user-visible error signatures. Call `POST /flags/{id}/pause-rollout`.
Sofia Rivera: I'll own flag metadata and blast-radius enforcement. Proposal: require `max_blast_radius` on creation, default 0.02 for experiments, server-side lint + CI check.
Ben Cho: I'll take telemetry and recurring-pattern detection. Will add a daily canary-anomaly job and a weekly aggregator to find slow drifts; backfill 30 days.
Anya Petrov: Good. Please paste PR links here when opened. I'll update the postmortem and schedule weekly 30m check-ins for 6 weeks.
Marcus Lee: Note: soft-pause mode that throttles rollout to 0.1% before full pause is useful to gather more signal. I'll include it.
Sofia Rivera: Suggested rollout YAML snippet for new flags:
```yaml
flag:
  max_blast_radius: 0.02
  initial_fraction: 0.005
  ramp_policy: [0.005, 0.02, 0.1, 1.0]
```
Ben Cho: Saved queries I'll add: `canary_error_spike` (3x baseline within 10m) and `p95_shift` (>=30% sustained). Alerts to #eng-oncall + owner.
infra-bot: Reminder: "Rollout safety follow-ups" weekly Mon 10:00 for 6 weeks created.
Anya Petrov: Owner matrix: Marcus -> rollback (proto Fri), Sofia -> flags/schema (PR Thu), Ben -> telemetry/dashboard (jobs Mon). I'll gather PRs and add dates to the postmortem.
Marcus Lee: Opened draft PR: https://git.redwood/ri/guardrails/pulls/510 (WIP)
Sofia Rivera: Opened draft PR: https://git.redwood/ri/flags/pulls/129 (WIP)
Ben Cho: Will post dashboard links in #eng-observability once wired.
Anya Petrov: Also agreed to rotate remediation owners monthly (primary + backup) so recurring patterns get continuous attention.
Marcus Lee: Agreed.
Sofia Rivera: Agreed.
Ben Cho: Agreed.
Anya Petrov: Thanks everyone — please react :white_check_mark: after your first PR merges so I can mark items closed in the postmortem.
